meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会启动一个新浏览器(或连接你已打开的 Chrome),操作真实网页:打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据;动作之间页面状态会保留。
howto.when: 当用户说“打开某个网址”“点击”“填写表单”等指令,或要求截图、抓取网页数据、测试网站等浏览器操作时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截一张整页截图并保存。
say.note: 会先打开页面,等待加载完成后截图。

say.text: 在 example.com 搜索 weather,列出结果标题。
say.note: 通过页面快照定位搜索框后输入并搜索。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com 的登录页,填写用户名密码并登录。
say.note: 若之前有登录会话,会继续使用同一页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can launch a fresh browser or connect to the user's Chrome and act on real pages: open URLs, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and extract data. Page state is kept between actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", etc., or requests screenshots, web scraping, website testing, logging in, or other browser interactions.

say_en.text: Open example.com, take a full-page screenshot, and save it.
say_en.note: It opens the page and captures it after load.

say_en.text: Search for 'weather' on example.com and list the result titles.
say_en.note: It finds the input via the page snapshot, then searches.

say_en.text: Open the login page on example.com, fill in my credentials, and log in.
say_en.note: An existing login session can be reused in the same page.
